title: The stress suite and stress_test.py are gone, and the heavy tier is the full tests.py alone
goal: By the operator's answer to gate g1 (recommended: delete), _tools/test_stress.py and _tools/stress_test.py no longer exist; nothing runs or names them: tests.py, testmap.py's RUNNERS, conftest's stress marker, perfcheck.py's stress selection and --stress, bl_base.REVIEW_CHECKS (the review story runs backlog.py check and the full tests.py), bl_intake's HEAVY_SCRIPTS, bl_land's and bl_selfcheck's lists, backlog.py's usage, .claude/settings.json's allow rules, the session-start hook, cleanhost-run.ps1, .gitlab-ci.yml (tool-stress and the Windows job's stress step), .github/workflows/kb.yml's stress job, pyproject.toml, the kb-setup, kb-verify, kb-sprint and kb-item skills, kb-worker.md and kb/_self's docs; the 98 stress ids are in _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt with the decision as their reason. Each sprint's heavy tier loses about 55 s on macOS (median of 219 committed stress runs) and about 8 min on the Windows host (462 s, kb/_self/reports/test-suite-speed.md), and every GitHub publish push one stress job. It no longer catches: the tools' behaviour on a kb copy with 3,000 extra topics, a 20 MB article, 100k citations, BOMs, CRLF and the other 40 mutations, and the corpus scaling bound; a real kb that grew that way shows in check.py, the lookup eval and the ops rows' tool times.

run: perfcheck or testmap or selfcheck or intake

gates.question: What happens to the stress suite (98 tests, test_stress.py, run by stress_test.py at each sprint's review, by kb-setup and kb-verify on request, by the manual GitLab tool-stress job, the Windows CI job and GitHub's stress job on every push)? delete = remove test_stress.py and stress_test.py and every caller; the heavy tier is the full tests.py alone. three = keep stress_test.py with three cases (test_corpus_scaling and two mutations: the 20 MB single-line article and the 100k citations), run at the review story only, no CI job. keep = no change.

notes: Rule, skill, bl_ and CI change: blocking operator gate g1 (recommended delete), under the operator's direction of 2026-10-05. Premise: 219 committed stress_test.py runs (ops rows test.run mode stress, 2026-10-02..05, macOS) have a median of 55 s wall; the Windows host's measured run is 462 s wall, 3,495 worker-s on 8 workers (kb/_self/reports/test-suite-speed.md: test_corpus_scaling 216 s, mutation cases 50-162 s each). Depends on ST-f2gtof46 because both rewrite the three test tiers in backlog.md, the skills and kb-worker.md. The referrers list came from backlog.py referrers _tools/stress_test.py _tools/test_stress.py on 2026-10-05; the ops sidecars and kb/public articles that name the script are data and stay; kb/_self/reports/windows-fresh-host.md is a dated report and stays. ST-pg5jyebo (a Windows session records a run of both suites) names the stress suite: its goal loses that half once this lands.
